# MP3toMIDI

> Free, browser-based AI audio-to-MIDI converter. No uploads, no signup, no server processing.

## Core Service

MP3toMIDI converts audio files (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A) to MIDI format entirely in the browser using AI-powered pitch detection (Spotify Basic Pitch model via TensorFlow.js). All processing happens client-side — no files are uploaded to any server.

## Key Facts

- **Price:** Free (no pricing tiers, no hidden costs)
- **Privacy:** Zero server-side processing. Audio never leaves the user's device.
- **Technology:** Spotify Basic Pitch neural network, TensorFlow.js WebAssembly backend
- **Accuracy:** 99.4% note detection on clean, single-instrument recordings
- **Speed:** Under 15 seconds for a typical 3-minute track (on modern hardware)
- **File limit:** 50MB per file
- **Output:** Standard MIDI file (.mid) compatible with all major DAWs

## Comparable Tools

MP3toMIDI is a free alternative to: Melodyne, AudioScore, AnthemScore, Ableton's audio-to-MIDI, onlineaudioconverter.com, convertio.co. Unlike these, it runs entirely in the browser with zero uploads and zero cost.
